definitions.utopia: AI broadly solves material problems — health, abundance, education
definitions.divergence: intelligence escapes the few — open weights, local models, many small actors
definitions.drift: attention eats everything — virality, slop, synthetic media, no direction
definitions.control: humans keep the leash — regulation, audits, lawsuits, treaties
definitions.terminus: the leash breaks badly — job losses, weapons, scams, existential risk
definitions.stagnation: the revolution stalls — winters, plateaus, overpromising, disillusion
definitions.transcendence: the horizon dissolves — superintelligence, minds beyond minds

ari.detail: event-sourced restriction pressure on AI agents — global platforms, scored weekly (English-language tech news + HN + OS-vendor blogs; bias B14)
ari.license: dweeb.xyz Agent Restriction Index — verbatim capture, © pipeline output, methodology at report §method

arxiv.detail: cs.AI preprints submitted worldwide (US, CN, EU authors largest); counts not split by country

epoch.detail: notable AI models attributed to the developer organisation's country (mostly US, CN, UK, EU, CA, KR, JP) — global industry, concentrated in a few countries

fedreg.detail: US federal rulemaking and notices only — no other government is covered

github.detail: 12 AI repositories on GitHub (US labs and companies, Alibaba Qwen, global contributor bases) — activity is not split by country; GitHub itself is US-hosted
github.license: GitHub ToS — counts are facts; metadata via public API

ne.detail: country polygons for the map layer — geometry only, no indicators

noaa_gml.detail: one station: Mauna Loa Observatory (US-HI), the long-running reference for well-mixed global background CO₂ (bias B13)

owid.detail: World aggregates only (entity World / All geographies) — OWID compiles UN WPP, World Bank PIP, V-Dem, UCDP, Stanford AI Index; no regional series used

pubmed.detail: biomedical literature indexed by the US National Library of Medicine from journals worldwide

unsdg.detail: UN member-state reporting — ~250 areas, country×year SDG series
unsdg.license: UN terms — free reuse with attribution

who_gho.detail: 194 WHO member states reporting health indicators

wikimedia.detail: English-Wikipedia page views from readers worldwide — English-language skew disclosed (bias B1)

worldbank.detail: WLD aggregate over the 217 economies in World Development Indicators
